items.title: Ray Brown interviewed by Monk Rowe, Scottsdale, AZ, April 16, 2000
items.q: Max Roach I had seen in the theater with Benny Carter

ctx.x: Yeah. And at intermission at that club it was a singer named Billy Daniels and the guy playing piano for him was a guy that I knew called Hank Jones, who is one of the premier pianists even right as I speak. And Hank and I had lived in the YMCA up in Buffalo years before, when I first left home, my first job. And so I said to my cousin, “Come on, let’s go in there, I’m going to see if I can find Hank because I know him.” And so I walked back and he was in the back and we talked for a few minutes and he said, “Sit…

we go back up to where we were, and I go to Dizzy Gillespie’s house the next day and there’s four guys there. Dizzy Gillespie, Charlie Parker, Bud Powell and Max Roach. Charlie Parker I had seen with Jay McShann. Bud Powell I had seen with Cootie Williams’ band. Max Roach I had seen in the theater with Benny Carter, and Dizzy I had seen with Cab. So I had seen all these people and I had heard them on record, but this was the first time. And then they started to play, it scared me to death. I mean I never heard…
Those guys weren’t all that much older than you, were they? Mid-twenties perhaps?
